verdict.rationale: Evidence only briefly mentions Gemini AI assistant in Gmail and Meet's 'Take notes for me' feature, hinting at natural-language AI capabilities embedded in Workspace apps, but there's no documentation of broad natural-language command operation across the product (e.g., voice/text commands to manage docs, sheets, admin tasks). Missing for 10: detailed docs on NL command scope, examples of commands across apps beyond Gmail/Meet, independent hands-on verification of NL command reliability.
